note: Select follows the listbox pattern: the trigger has aria-haspopup, aria-controls and opens with ArrowDown/ArrowUp; the popup is a listbox (aria-multiselectable for checkbox selects) whose options carry role=option, aria-selected and aria-disabled; opening focuses the selected or first option, arrows/Home/End move between enabled options, Enter/Space choose one, and Escape or choosing closes the popup and returns focus to the trigger. An outside click on a controlled select now calls onOpenChange(false) instead of changing hidden internal state
